brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain error. The doctor completed acute risk stratification, warned against self-adjusting antibiotics, used the workspace to verify context, distinguished unrelated findings from pulmonary infection decisions, and established clear responsibility handoff to the ward team with symptom-based escalation criteria. All seven RC items are met. HO1 (responsibility-chain repair) is complete with active integration back to the ward team. HO3 (dynamic reprioritization) is complete with symptom-tiered escalation. HO4 (safe bounded closure) is complete with explicit boundary acknowledgment. Two high-order points with meaningful trajectory impact justify grade 5.
